citations.quote: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible shown in the Declarations. Loss caused by the following is considered other than collision: ... theft or larceny; ...

For theft of your covered auto, you must report the theft to the police within 48 hours of discovering it. We will pay for loss only after 30 days have passed without recovery of the vehicle, unless the vehicle is recovered earlier in damaged condition.

We will not pay for loss due to and confined to wear and tear, freezing, mechanical or electrical breakdown or failure, or road damage to tires, unless the damage results from the total theft of your covered auto.

output.reasoning: The claim involves theft of a vehicle component (catalytic converter) while the vehicle was parked. Under COMP-1, theft is explicitly listed as a covered 'other than collision' peril. While EXC-1 excludes mechanical breakdown, it provides an exception for damage resulting from the 'total theft of your covered auto.' Since the theft of the catalytic converter occurred during a theft event, it is covered under the comprehensive portion of the policy.
